user.title: San Jose Water
user.description: Sign in with your SJWaterHUB login (sjwaterhub.com). Needs a smart meter: the integration reads its hourly readings for the Energy dashboard and for leak and high-use alerts. Unofficial; not affiliated with San Jose Water.

account.title: Choose an account
account.description: This login has more than one San Jose Water account. Pick one; add the integration again for the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: SJWaterHUB no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Username or password not accepted by SJWaterHUB.
error.verification_required: SJWaterHUB wants an extra step first (verification code, email confirmation or password change). Sign in once at sjwaterhub.com in a browser, then try again.
error.account_locked: SJWaterHUB has temporarily blocked sign-in for this login (too many attempts or a disabled profile). Wait 15 minutes or check at sjwaterhub.com.
error.no_usage_data: No hourly smart-meter readings were found for this account. They appear once San Jose Water has installed a smart meter at the address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SJWaterHUB, or it answered unexpectedly. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

init.title: San Jose Water options
init.description: How often to check SJWaterHUB and when to flag leaks or unusual use.

data_description.scan_interval: Hours between checks (1-6). SJWaterHUB adds new readings every few hours.
data_description.high_day_percent: High daily usage turns on when yesterday's use reaches this share of your 30-day daily average.
data_description.high_hour_gallons: High hourly usage turns on when any hour in the last 24 used at least this much (a hose or sprinkler left running is often 300-600 gal/h).
data_description.continuous_hours: Possible leak turns on when water was used in this many consecutive hours. Homes normally have idle hours every day.
data_description.overnight_start: Start hour (0-23) of the nightly window when your home normally uses no water.
data_description.overnight_end: End hour (0-23, exclusive). Possible leak turns on if every hour in the window used water. Move the window if irrigation runs at night.
data_description.stale_hours: Data delayed turns on when SJWaterHUB has not published new readings for this long.
